data.body: Plan-review PASS (0 blocking, 3 advisory). Advisory notes: (1) the '>=3.0.0' in the oauthlib provenance is requests-oauthlib's own requirement on oauthlib (requests-oauthlib 2.0.0 declares oauthlib>=3.0.0), so 4.0.1 is admitted; jira pulls requests-oauthlib unversioned. (2) #16 and #17 are medium oauthlib alerts in uv.lock (GHSA-xpv3-w29h-x7cv, GHSA-hj66-6f7g-4r5v), both patched in 4.0.0, so the same bump clears them. pip-audit over a fresh 'uv sync --locked --extra dev' env of the new lock: no known vulnerabilities.
